body:
Rounds 1-9. Converged. zmux is a zmx with opinions: a shell wrapper installed by overlay that makes `project.id` names into labels, births sessions in a transient systemd scope, and brackets `run` with state. Plus an elisp rewrite and a vocabulary document.

No Rust binary, no forks, no store, daemon, TUI, manifest, MCP, picker, reader or new dependencies. The repo shrinks: the crate and its crane packaging go away, leaving a wrapper, its argv tests, the elisp, the doc and flake wiring.

Next: build. Write the wrapper against stub zmx/systemd-run binaries first (argv assertions, as dl-zmx-test does), delete the crate, then rewrite the elisp on top, then document the vocabulary.
title: zmux: what are we building
